risks.title: API observation/IP trust
risks.scenario: Network exposure with observe or shared proxy identity.
risks.controls: Enforce rejects unknown clients; credential identities available.
risks.next_action: Set enforce and locked policy; separate client tokens.
risks.validation_gap: V1: proxy/IP behavior needs deployment tests.

risks.title: Control behind a local proxy
risks.scenario: Proxy enters the unauthenticated loopback exception.
risks.controls: A control port without users answers 503, also on loopback (ADR-0053); unauthenticated loopback only with the boolean control_auth.allow_unauthenticated_loopback, a literal loopback listener and a loopback peer; a start warning names the state.
risks.next_action: Keep the regression in CI; deployments behind a proxy configure Control users and TLS.
risks.validation_gap: V2: a real reverse-proxy topology is not part of CI; the unit tests model its loopback peer.
risks.evidence: selftest_security: loopback peer without users is refused (503, handler not called) unless the switch is set; the switch does not open remote peers or a wildcard listener; the check fails against router 0.18.2.

risks.title: Admin browser attacks
risks.scenario: Cross-site admin request or same-origin compromise.
risks.controls: Non-simple header and Fetch Metadata checks.
risks.validation_gap: V3: real browser tests still required.

risks.title: Concrete-model authorization
risks.scenario: Role-limited client chooses a concrete model.
risks.controls: Concrete model names need an explicit boolean models:true (ADR-0052); a missing setting means roles only and is named in a load-time warning; a non-boolean value is a configuration error.
risks.next_action: Consider per-client model allowlists; keep the grant tests in CI.
risks.validation_gap: Model listings still show concrete names to role-only clients (information, not access). Both proxy call sites use auth.client_allows; protocol coverage relies on that shared check.
risks.evidence: selftest_security: missing setting, models:true, a truthy non-boolean, the UI client and the configuration default; the new checks fail against router 0.18.2 (missing setting denies concrete names).

risks.title: Cloud classification
risks.scenario: Incorrect declaration or classifier false negative forwards sensitive data.
risks.controls: Client class floor, cloud opt-out, secret scan.
risks.next_action: Test final payload and explicit privacy exception.
risks.validation_gap: V5: end-to-end no-egress and classifier quality not proven.

risks.title: Cloud transport/destinations
risks.scenario: HTTP provider or redirect leaves approved transport/host.
risks.controls: Allowlisted final HTTPS URL, with HTTP limited to explicit loopback. Every provider POST refuses redirects.
risks.next_action: Keep transport tests in CI and verify effective provider configuration when deploying.
risks.validation_gap: Synthetic endpoints cover application dispatch. Operator TLS termination and infrastructure remain deployment-specific.
risks.evidence: Both provider adapters reject 3xx before parsing or streaming the response; the second origin receives zero HTTP requests.

risks.title: Agent enrollment and compromise
risks.scenario: Pending-slot flood or compromised approved agent.
risks.controls: Ed25519 approval, bounded pending and per-IP admission.

risks.title: Resource and cost exhaustion
risks.scenario: Pre-auth flood, long streams or parallel costly inference.
risks.controls: Client rate and enrollment limits. Unauthenticated statistics capped at 1024 sources (LRU, evictions counted); their audit lines limited per source and event kind and by a global per-minute budget with withheld counts (ADR-0057).
risks.next_action: Concurrency, time, byte and cost bounds for authenticated and tunnel traffic; WebSocket handshake limits under load.
risks.validation_gap: V12: pre-auth state and audit volume are bounded and unit-tested; hostile-load budgets for authenticated traffic remain open.

risks.title: Session and memory isolation
risks.scenario: Stolen token or foreign UUID/project alias access.
risks.next_action: Test every route and token/grant rotation.
risks.validation_gap: V8: complete endpoint and deployment coverage needed.

risks.title: Memory poisoning and tool injection
risks.scenario: Shared writer injects false facts or tool instructions.
risks.next_action: Minimize writer rights; independently authorize tools.
risks.validation_gap: V9: downstream agent/tool behavior is outside unit-test coverage.

risks.title: Backend bypass and independent egress
risks.scenario: Direct backend access or its own cloud extraction.
risks.controls: Gateway-scoped grants on the router path only.
risks.next_action: Restrict backend reachability and credentials; audit backend egress.
risks.validation_gap: V5/V8: requires deployment inspection; no gateway test proves this.

risks.title: Deletion retry and restoration
risks.scenario: Old outbox/backup resurrects data; session deletion leaves memory.
risks.controls: Outbox reauthorization, tombstones and selective deletion.
risks.next_action: Define lifecycle across all stores; test crash and restore.
risks.validation_gap: V11: restore and backup policies require integration/operational tests.

risks.title: Update trust and rollback
risks.scenario: Compromised release or old valid manifest.
risks.controls: Signed agent manifest and hash; separate Ollama source/checksum. Since agent 0.28.0 the agent refuses a signed version older than the running release (ADR-0054); deliberate rollback only with the node-local update.allow_downgrade switch.
risks.next_action: Define signing-key rotation and recovery; practise a rotation.
risks.validation_gap: V13: anti-rollback is implemented and unit-tested; signing-key rotation and recovery are not.

risks.title: Host privilege escalation impact
risks.scenario: Router/agent compromise reaches privileged host operations.
risks.next_action: Test dedicated user and separate privileged agent operations.
risks.validation_gap: V13: unprivileged deployment and recovery still need staging.

risks.title: Logs telemetry and backups
risks.scenario: Metadata/secrets leak or local audit is altered.
risks.controls: Audit omits prompts and tokens; router-written files are owner-only (common.open_private, unit UMask=0077, ADR-0056); a CI canary test covers client and control authentication, inference paths and token rotation.
risks.next_action: Log rotation and retention, backup controls for these files, independent audit retention; canaries for memory and session paths.
risks.validation_gap: V14: the canary test covers authentication, inference without a node and token rotation; memory, session and upstream error paths, rotation and backups are not covered.

risks.title: Supply chain and CI
risks.controls: pip-audit on runtime and optional requirement sets, govulncheck and Dependabot (actions, Go, monitoring compose, decision-service Dockerfiles). Third-party actions pinned to commit SHAs, tools to versions, images and base images to digests, enforced by test/check_pinned_references.py (ADR-0055). Default-branch PR verification on an isolated hosted runner, App-bound merge status and same-dependency bump checks.
risks.next_action: Hash-locked Python installs; SBOM and provenance for release artifacts.
risks.validation_gap: V14: Python application requirements are version ranges without hashes; release artifact provenance remains open.
